- **API confirmations (they change how (e) is written, all verified by reading the code):** (1) `propose.propose_for(site_id, plan_id, root=ROOT)` - default root is the CHECKOUT; `batch_us._entry` calls it 2-arg (default), and the test's `_check_entry` must call it identically (same call, same hard-linked data) - never pass the tmp tree as root. (2) `review.upsert_item`: same-plan entries replace IN PLACE (position kept), new plans appended, resolved write-once, lead follows candidates[0].plan - so in a run that only appends/replaces, the lead (and the item file name) can never move: the tests may assert exactly one item file per site. (3) `matchfit.reachable()` wraps urlopen in `except Exception: return False` - the dead-socket guard's AssertionError becomes False, no crash; in every hermetic line run the matcher is unreachable and never called (the fit summary line prints instead). (4) `plan_fit.who_placed`: `by` hand/agent wins, else `auto` -> agent, else None - the case-b seed (golden doc minus its auto mark) is refused, as pinned. (5) Fixture contents for (f): records.json header.confident.expected_stdout is 11 lines with line 0 = the deleted "fit  no model given..." line; records_unsure.json header.unsure.expected_stdout is 8 lines (line 0 deleted; line 2 the matcher's "not sure: 8 consistent points (need 10)" print; lines 3 and 6 carrying "no model answer"), item[0].why = "no model answer", best = 8 inliers.
